mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.user_type, u.status, COALESCE(p.real_name, d.real_name, u.username) AS display_name, p.id AS patient_id, d.id AS doctor_id, d.department_id, dp.name AS department_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN patient p ON p.user_id = u.id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN doctor d ON d.user_id = u.id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN department dp ON dp.id = d.department_id WHERE u.deleted = 0 ORDER BY u.id DESC

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.user_type, u.status, COALESCE(p.real_name, d.real_name, u.username) AS display_name, p.id AS patient_id, d.id AS doctor_id, d.department_id, dp.name AS department_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN patient p ON p.user_id = u.id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN doctor d ON d.user_id = u.id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN department dp ON dp.id = d.department_id WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.id = #{id}
SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{id} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.id

SELECT p.permission_code FROM sys_permission p WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{id} AND r.status = 1 AND rp.permission_id = p.id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_permission up WHERE up.user_id = #{id} AND up.permission_id = p.id ) ORDER BY p.permission_code
